scenarios.when: GET https://api.puretokensx.com/api/product/desktop/account/balance is not authenticated or cannot be executed
scenarios.then: report the returned status or error and direct the user to the Pure Tokens client balance view; do not estimate or request credentials

scenarios.when: a balance read is requested and no separate specialized balance interface is exposed
scenarios.then: resolve one matching current-host credential privately in memory and issue the fixed balance GET through the host terminal or native HTTPS capability; do not report a missing interface before trying the request

scenarios.when: the fixed Pure Tokens balance API returns a balance response
scenarios.then: report only returned fields once; do not retry or infer omitted values
